_comment: Copy this file to dart_defines.json (gitignored) and paste your real key. Then run/build with --dart-define-from-file=dart_defines.json so the AI key is compiled into the app. WITHOUT this, AiConfig.apiKey is empty and the assistant shows as unavailable in release builds — the reason 'AI works locally but not in the shipped app'. Values must be strings.
_recommended: Set ONLY AI_ASSISTANT_PROXY_URL to your deployed web /api/assistant — then the server holds the key and NO key ships in the app. Leave AI_ASSISTANT_API_KEY empty. Fill the key ONLY if you are not using a proxy.
